tasks.short: Provide analytical support for climate policy briefs.

steps.what: Verify the policy question, actual energy or climate datasets and their geographic and time boundaries
Calculate explicit energy, efficiency or emissions comparisons for policy-brief support in {SPREADSHEET}
Provide analytical support by interpreting policy comparisons, uncertainty, distributional effects and limits
Complete and check the analytical support sheet with native linked tables and actual interpretation in {DOCS}
Save the checked analytical support sheet in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure explicit comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET} and native linked tables in {DOCS}. The analyst verifies source scope, chooses assumptions and interprets the findings; support-sheet assembly does not become a policy decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison arithmetic and table transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and linked tables can reuse explicit calculations.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when an apparently precise comparison misleads.

ambition.what: No new policy authority is assumed.

evidence.claim: Explicit formulas and linked tables can support policy analysis while interpretation remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is analytical support and its support sheet, not writing the stakeholder brief in 16850. Calculations are supplied once; downstream briefs reuse them without another analysis saving.

Source publishers supply series ID, actual value, unit, geography, period, method and revision. The analyst supplies comparison assumptions and checks missing or incompatible fields manually in s1-s3.
Native formulas first. Only arithmetic and table transfer change, not assumption choice or interpretation. Final author checking in s4 binds the saved version. Shares are provisional estimates.
unknowns: Existing formula coverage and dataset compatibility.
research_questions: Can linked tables preserve the source revision and uncertainty notes?

already_counted.description: Source verification and analytical interpretation remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact analytical support sheet checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 calculation plus 2.8 table-transfer points less 1.5 upkeep. Low is existing formulas or incompatible datasets; no interpretive saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Propose fuel, freight and climate policies.

steps.what: Evaluate actual policy constraints, evidence and stakeholder impacts for traditional or alternative fuels and goods transport
Compare explicit fuel and freight policy scenarios using native assumptions tables and formulas in {SPREADSHEET}
Propose new or modified policies by weighing climate effects, feasibility, distribution and trade-offs
Write and check the final policy proposal in {DOCS}, linking the approved scenario table and preserving limits and intended recipients
Save the checked policy proposal in {DOCS}
Send the checked proposal to the designated external policy stakeholders through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Configure explicit policy scenarios in {SPREADSHEET} and reuse their checked tables in {DOCS}. The analyst chooses and explains the policy recommendation and checks the complete proposal before separate save and stakeholder send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scenario arithmetic and repeated table transfer can crowd out policy judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas and linked tables handle explicit assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing climate outcomes with feasibility and unequal impacts.
tasks.human_edge: Policy judgement and making trade-offs explicit.

ambition.what: No power to enact policy is added.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical scenario work, unchanged recommendation authority.

evidence.claim: Explicit scenario formulas can compare policy inputs, but choosing a policy requires human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes this policy proposal and its delivery, not enacting rules. Scenario comparisons distinct from an already completed analytical-support sheet are counted only where actually performed; reused 16849 analysis is not recreated or credited twice.

Publishers supply actual fuel factors, activity units, year, scope and provenance; the analyst verifies those inputs and supplies explicit policy assumptions in s1-s2. Missing factors require manual research within retained work.

Native tools first. No model selects the recommendation. Proposal assembly savings concern linked tables and structure, not substantive argument. Normal final checking in s4 covers the completed content and exact external recipients; edits void both gates.
unknowns: Which comparisons are new rather than reused from prior support work.
research_questions: Do scenario formulas preserve uncertainty and avoid false causal precision?

already_counted.description: Policy evidence evaluation and recommendation choice remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact policy proposal checked in s4; edits void approval.
Exact proposal and stakeholder recipients checked in s4; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 7 scenario plus 4.6 table-and-structure points less 1.5 upkeep. Low is existing formulas or a proposal relying entirely on already assembled analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare written materials for government or environmental groups.

steps.what: Select and verify the actual environmental evidence, approved analytical findings and audience requirements for the written material
Prepare study reports, memoranda, briefs or testimonies as a complete draft in {DOCS}, using only the verified evidence pack

loop.purpose: Draft audience-specific prose from a fixed verified evidence pack
loop.input: Source text with stable passage IDs, approved findings, audience and outline
loop.output: Draft with passage references for every factual claim and number
loop.check: Analyst verifies every claim, caveat, reference and number against actual sources in s3, including meaning and omissions
loop.stop: One draft and at most one correction; any unsupported claim or lost caveat returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates cover structure but cannot express nonstandard source prose for the intended audience

steps.what: Edit and check the complete material against actual sources, uncertainties, audience purpose and final government or environmental-group recipients
Save the checked written material in {DOCS}
Send the checked material to the designated government or environmental-group recipients through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Start with native document structure in {DOCS}; use one bounded prose loop only for varied audience-specific writing from a verified evidence pack. The analyst checks every claim and caveat in the completed material before separate save and external send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific prose requires repeated drafting from existing analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source-linked draft can assist prose without creating evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific accuracy, balanced framing and preserving uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: Editorial responsibility and knowing how the audience may misread a claim.

ambition.what: No extra public communication volume is assumed.

tasks.altitude: More time on source fidelity and argument, unchanged editorial responsibility.

reach.task: Adapt technical findings to an audience

evidence.claim: A bounded source-linked model draft can assist varied prose, but factual claims, omissions and meaning need full human verification.

assumptions: Boundary is composing and delivering this written material from existing verified analysis. Analytical support in 16849 and research synthesis in 16854 are inputs when already completed and earn no second saving here.

The analyst assembles actual document ID, revision, source passage, approved finding, unit and caveat in s1, fully counted. Missing passages or untraceable numbers require manual writing; the model cannot invent a reference.

Test native templates first and use the loop only where prose varies. s2 retains substantial human drafting and correction; s3 retains full final verification. No automatic publication or model policy judgement is allowed.

The normal editorial check in s3 binds exact finished content and recipient set after the draft exists. Any edit voids both references. Ordinary save and send retain full time; estimates are provisional, not measured.
unknowns: Source-pack quality and actual correction effort on audience-specific prose.
research_questions: Does assisted drafting save time after every claim and caveat is checked?

already_counted.description: Evidence-pack preparation and full final editorial checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source-link checks and review recurring drafting errors.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final material checked in s3; edits require recheck.
Exact material and external recipient set checked in s3; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 40% less drafting on 50 share gives 20 points less 3 upkeep, with full evidence and editorial checks. Low is failed source-link checks or native templates already sufficient; retain manual writing then.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze and distill climate research for stakeholders.

steps.what: Read actual climate-related research findings and assess methods, scope, uncertainty and applicability
Arrange verified findings, source identifiers, scope and caveats in the native evidence table {DOCS}
Analyze and distill findings by reconciling conflicting results and identifying defensible implications for legislators, agencies or other stakeholders
Write and check the distilled research findings and limits for the actual stakeholder question
Save the checked research synthesis note in {DOCS}
Send the checked synthesis note to the designated external stakeholder through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Configure a native evidence table in {DOCS} to reuse verified source identifiers and fixed comparison fields. The analyst reads papers, resolves conflicting findings and writes the synthesis; this task does not create a second stakeholder brief already owned by 16850.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence comparison repeats bibliographic fields and table structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables can reuse actual citation records.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling different methods and explaining what follows for a stakeholder.

ambition.what: No extra research coverage is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less evidence-table setup, unchanged analytical authority.

evidence.claim: Native evidence tables can reuse bibliographic structure while research interpretation and synthesis remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is research analysis and the distilled synthesis note and its direct delivery. A formal brief that packages this note belongs to 16850; if delivery happens there, this note send is omitted rather than credited twice.

Publishers supply actual paper ID, title, year and source text. The analyst supplies verified finding, method, scope and caveat in s1-s2; substantive capture remains. Missing citation metadata is checked manually, not invented or accepted from generated summaries.

Native tables first. Only repeated structure and bibliographic reuse change; full reading, conflict resolution and substantive writing remain. The digest's summarization option is not relied on as scientific analysis. Normal final checking in s4 covers the exact note and stakeholder recipient.
unknowns: Amount of repeated bibliographic entry and existing reference-table setup.
research_questions: Does the evidence table retain incompatible methods rather than falsely averaging findings?

already_counted.description: Full research reading, synthesis and final note writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain evidence-table fields and citation mapping.

approvals.approved_version: Exact synthesis note checked in s4; edits require recheck.
Exact synthesis note and stakeholder recipient checked in s4; edits require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35% less evidence-table assembly on 20 share saves 7 points less 0.75 upkeep. Low is existing citation reuse; no reading, synthesis or send saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit comparisons and traceable source packs while retaining policy and editorial judgement.
reach: Help advisers explain climate evidence without losing caveats.
role.ambitious_version: A policy analyst whose proposals and communications distinguish verified evidence from policy choices.
